name: Linxia

routes.outcome: Official Linxia City Natural Resources Bureau government-information page fetched successfully. It documents the bureau and information-disclosure process, but exposes no public parcel viewer or anonymous parcel-vector endpoint.

Official Linxia Hui Autonomous Prefecture Natural Resources Bureau planning/land-use information page fetched successfully. It is general agency information, not evidence of a city-bounded cadastral service.
Official standard-map service page fetched successfully and linked the Gansu Tianditu portal; no parcel layer or safe parcel response was exposed.

First-party Gansu Tianditu landing page fetched successfully. Its public JavaScript/configuration identifies standard basemap WMTS routes and an online mapping entrypoint, but no city parcel layer or anonymous cadastral API.

Current portal configuration inspected. It lists public/government basemap services and a public online-mapping/login route; no Linxia parcel service, parcel schema, or safe native identity endpoint was found.
Public mapping entrypoint returned a small shell page. No anonymous parcel response, service schema, CRS, or parcel geometry was obtained.
Configured resource-center login path returned 404; no login was attempted and no credentials, CAPTCHA, or private token was used.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Gansu Tianditu public config inspected; only standard basemap and portal routes were identified.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No parcel geometry response obtained; CRS and coordinate order remain unverified.

localCustodianAssessment: The official Linxia City Natural Resources Bureau page evidences a local natural-resources information custodian, and the prefectural bureau pages evidence the higher-level natural-resources authority. They do not evidence a publicly queryable cadastral map or parcel-vector service. General national/provincial material was not treated as local registry evidence.

qualification.reason: No anonymous parcel geometry or city-bounded public vector response was verified; serial review must independently qualify any real adapter before runtime consideration.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted to force a hit.
No exact-point parcel hit or miss was used as a citywide absence claim.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate, or personal fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe full parcel polygon and native identity were obtained.
The public mapping shell and configuration were inspected only through ordinary anonymous GET requests; no login, credential, CAPTCHA, private token, or TLS bypass was used.
This packet records research completion only and is not source integration or registry admission.
uncertainty: Local custodianship is supported, but anonymous parcel-service reachability, viewer/API configuration, parcel schema/CRS, coverage, update cadence, licensing, and runtime behavior remain unverified. The absence of a public vector endpoint is an access/discovery limitation, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
